Recognition and speech use services installed on your device. Some services or voices may use the network. Voices vary by device and engine. This app does not store recordings.

Off by default. Only newly completed replies are read while this chat is visible. History, failed and interrupted replies are not read automatically. Leaving chat or switching to the background stops playback without resuming.
Selections are saved on this device immediately. Voice names and languages are provided by the system engine.
No installed voices are available to list.
For more voices, install a speech engine and language data in system settings, then reopen chat.
System speech is unavailable. Text chat still works. Install or enable a speech engine, then reopen chat.
The saved voice is unavailable. Using the system default; choose another voice if needed.
Chinese speech data is unavailable. Install Chinese speech data or choose another installed voice.
Speech failed. Check the voice, language data or network. The text reply is retained.
Could not save speech settings. Please retry.
Audio is unavailable right now. Retry with this chat in the foreground.
No text was recognized. Your draft is retained.
The combined text exceeds 12,000 characters. Your draft was not changed. Shorten it and retry.
Speech recognition could not finish. Your draft is retained; keyboard input is still available.
Speech was added to your draft. Review the text, then tap Send.
No speech recognition service is available. Install or enable one; keyboard input is still available.
Speak now. The system service may use the network. Review the recognized text before sending.
